exposure: Mode of delivery (cesarean section vs. vaginal delivery)
Type of anesthesia during cesarean section (general vs. regional)
cohort: 36 pregnant women with PH at Peking Union Medical College Hospital between January 2009 and June 2018
finding: Maternal mortality was associated with PH classification, severity, delayed diagnosis, and NYHA classification, while regional anesthesia appeared superior to general anesthesia for cesarean section in this cohort.
mod_finding: Cesarean section with general anesthesia was associated with higher mortality (3/16) compared to the overall maternal mortality rate (3/36).
